request.query: Decide satisfiability of a finite Boolean CNF and return an exact satisfying assignment or UNSAT certificate

matches.description: Decide whether a canonical residue-tuple frequency set is a spectrum of a point set in an explicit product of cyclic groups, including empty and singleton degenerate cases. Uses the fixed positive dual pairing chi_lambda(a) = exp(2*pi*i*sum_j lambda_j*a_j/m_j), proves every required character sum zero by exact integer-polynomial reduction modulo Phi_lcm(m_j), and returns the first nonzero exact remainder on failure.
matches.title: Decide an exact finite-Abelian spectral pair

matches.description: Normalize two bounded integer-vector factors in a declared product of cyclic groups, exhaustively count every sum representation, and decide whether every group element has exactly one representation.
matches.title: Exact finite abelian group factorization

matches.description: Compute ordered marginals and every positive-support likelihood ratio for one bounded normalized rational joint table. Return the exact identity scale*I=log_base(product), without floating point.
matches.title: Exact finite-table mutual information certificate

matches.description: Compute one bounded raw moment of a normalized finite exact rational distribution, preserving every atom contribution. Order one is the distribution's exact expectation or expected value.
matches.title: Exact finite-distribution raw moment

matches.description: Check whether two nonzero finite-field vectors are nonzero scalar multiples of each other.
matches.title: Decide whether two vectors define the same projective point

result.query: Decide satisfiability of a finite Boolean CNF and return an exact satisfying assignment or UNSAT certificate
